description: This file defines the SignUpPage widget for a Flutter app, which provides a user interface for signing up with fields for first name, last name, phone number, invitation code, and options for sign-up via email or social login. It also includes navigation to SignInPage and custom UI components.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the sign-up page UI with input fields and navigation controls.

classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a styled button for signing up.

classes.description: A stateless widget that provides buttons for social login via Facebook and Google.
